samples.notes: UNESCO Courier Jan-Mar 2026, 8-page excerpt (merges former basic-en and passage-en fixtures; issue pp. 4-6, 9, 12-13, 38 plus the contents page). PDF p1: contents grid with dotted page leaders, section headers, sharing the page with the editorial (Agnes Bardon). p2: article opener, oversized italic display title, author rail with bio, large embroidered-photo artwork. p3: display-title continuation with near-full-page artwork and rotated credit rail. p4: drop cap, two/three-column body, centered pull quote, boxed sidebar (LINKS programme). p5: article opener with standfirst, author rail, bottom photo with caption. p6: three-column body (IDEAS), boxed feature (2025 quantum year), left-rail pull quote, right-edge full-height illustration. p7: article opener with drop cap, three-column body, bottom pull quote, two-author sidebar rail. p8: top full-width photo with caption and right pull quote, three-column body, end-of-article marker.

Vogue (US) Winter 2025, 3-page excerpt. p1: FENDI full-page advertisement (photo, brand wordmark, vertical rail with boutique contact). p2: OMEGA full-page advertisement (product photo, tagline, body blurb, brand mark; vertical rail with URL). p3: contents page - masthead wordmark, issue date, hero photo with caption block, multi-column TOC grid with page numbers and blurbs, 'Cover Look' boxed sidebar with two cover thumbnails, bottom folio (p.22), vertical credits rail.

CERN Courier Jul-Aug 2026 (Vol 66 No 4), digital-edition excerpt. CAUTION: digital edition is paginated as landscape TWO-PAGE SPREADS with a persistent navigation chrome bar (masthead + icon buttons) along the bottom of every PDF page; print typography is otherwise preserved. p1 spread: front cover (masthead, cover lines, full-bleed photo) + welcome/editorial column. p2 spread: full-page conference advertisement (IBIC 2026) + 'In This Issue' contents (department grid, article thumbnails with blurbs and page numbers). p3 spread: full-page vendor advertisement (Bergoz) + News Analysis page (dense single-story news layout, margin pull quote, photo with caption). p4 spread: feature spread 'Culture and History' pp. 24-25 (three-column dense body, multiple captioned photos, right-rail pull quote). Technical/trade-magazine density pole of the corpus; real commercial ads.

Supersedes AramcoWorld-en.pdf. 9 pages: v1 pages 1-6 unchanged (cover, masthead, contents, issue p30, p33, p34); NEW page 7 = issue p35 (Hijaz feature continuation: top photo, two-column body, boxed section heading STEAMING AHEAD, right margin caption, bottom map figure); pages 8-9 = former 7-8 (Reviews p40-41). Purpose of v2: issue p34->p35 is a real mid-sentence page split ('a scarcity of water along much of' -> 'the route south of the Hauran'); p35 tail dangles mid-sentence ('...where a', continuation p36 absent) making 7->8 a new non-adjacent trap.

Supersedes FD-en.pdf. 9 pages: v1 pages 1-6 unchanged; NEW page 7 = issue p7 (Kaleidoscope continuation: Overheard quote rail with portraits, IN THE NEWS photo brief, By the numbers bar-chart panel - first infographic/quote-rail-dense page in corpus); pages 8-9 = former 7-8 (PoV p10, Currency Notes p72). NOTE: issue p6 ends with a complete sentence; 6->7 is a clean same-department boundary, NOT a chain positive.

Official Chinese edition of UNESCO Courier Jan-Mar 2026; page-for-page parallel of Courier-en.pdf (zh issue folio = en folio - 2: en p4<->zh p2, en p12<->zh p10, en p38<->zh p36). 8 pages mirroring Courier-en structure: contents+editorial, opener (display title split across pp.2-3), body with LINKS box, Brazil opener (zh p7), quantum body (zh p36), biopiracy opener (zh p10), biopiracy continuation (zh p11). Contains the official MID-WORD page split at zh p10->p11 ('...协议中包' / '含惠益分享条款') cited in the b5.3 evidence set. Official renderings for reference: biopiracy=生物剽窃, spinifex=三齿稃, masthead=联合国教科文组织《信使》. Serves as parallel reference for translation_eval; zh-source chain testing (zh->en) is a future use.

HuaweiTech 2026 No.1 (华为技术有限公司内刊), digital-edition excerpt, 5 pages. CAUTION: paginated as landscape TWO-PAGE SPREADS (two logical pages, two folios and running heads per PDF page), the corpus's second spread sample and its first zh-source one. p1 spread: masthead panel (staff list of ~30 Chinese names in dense rows, copyright block, no-warranty legal boilerplate, QR code, contact block) + foreword 刊首语 by 马海旭 with portrait, sunk initial, and a handwritten signature drawn as an image (image-layer, no-OCR scope exclusion, same family as Courier-zh p1); the issue's TOC grid (article titles, authors, page numbers grouped by section) shares this opening spread. p2: section divider, image-dominant orange graphic with the section title and a corner note marking the artwork as AI-assisted. p3 spread: article opener 电信运营商AItoB发展策略演进研究 by 许志远 with byline photo, abstract box, banner photo across the top, two-column body on both logical pages, sunk initial (目); a column boundary on the right logical page cuts a sentence mid-word (各 | 行各业), a ground-truth positive chain. p4 spread: article body continuation both sides, dense two-column technical prose, numbered references [1][2] with superscript citation marks in the body, article closes with an end-mark. p5 spread: second article opener 超越连接 by Brian Washburn with sunk initial (过), two statistics charts whose axis labels, legends and data labels are vector text, numbered figure captions. Technical/corporate-journal pole of the zh side; exercises spread column-band handling, superscript-citation handling, terminology consistency pinning (算力/Token/AItoB) and bulk pinyin romanization of the staff list.

Official Chinese edition of ABB Review 01/2024, 9-page excerpt. p1: cover with section teasers. pp2-3: graphical and conventional issue contents. p4: Innovation section divider. p5: CEO editorial. p6: Innovation divider with two photo teasers. p7: numbered index of selected innovation briefs. p8: self-contained ABB Dynafin brief with two-column body and product image. p9: separate self-contained 800xA Simulator What-if brief with two-column body and process diagram; p8->p9 is NOT a chain. Branded industrial-technology layout with sparse dividers, dense indexes, diagrams and mixed Chinese/Latin product names. Chinese-source zh->en baseline only; the official English edition supplies terminology reference.

Official Chinese edition of IAEA Bulletin, February 2020, Nuclear Security, 9-page excerpt. p1: front cover. p2: imprint and institutional profile. p3: Director General foreword with drop cap, pull quote and image strip. pp4-5: two-page contents sequence. pp6-7: full-page illustrated explainer with sparse running text and labelled sectors. pp8-9: Senegal feature opener and dense continuation. REAL semantic cuts: p6->p7 ('从实物保护到' -> '核安保文化') and p8->p9 (the personal name 'Zéphirin' -> 'Ouédraogo说'). Strong infographic, editorial and technical-feature coverage. Chinese-source zh->en baseline only; the official English edition supplies terminology reference.

Official Chinese edition of Finance & Development, March 2017 (Vol. 54 No. 1), 6-page excerpt. p1: Growth Conundrum cover. p2: imprint rail sharing the page with the main contents. p3: contents continuation sharing the page with the editor's letter. p4: 'Stuck in a Rut' feature opener with standfirst, three-column body and a large bottom photo. pp5-6: chart-heavy three-column article body. REAL mid-sentence split p4->p5 ('疲弱' -> '的生产力增长将严重威胁...'); p5->p6 is the same article but a clean paragraph boundary. Economics magazine pole with dense prose, captions and quantitative charts. Chinese-source zh->en baseline only; the official English edition supplies terminology reference.

Official Chinese edition of ITU News Magazine 06/2019, 8-page excerpt on WRC-19. p1: front cover. p2: editorial with narrow body column and large pull quote. p3: contents plus imprint rail. p4: WRC-19 highlights opener with title, captions and photo collage. pp5-6: full-page portrait-and-quotation pages. p7: 'Reaching consensus in Egypt for future digital communications' opener with drop cap, photograph and two-column body. p8: clean continuation with a body column and stacked memorial/video sidebars. The p4->p5 and p5->p6 boundaries are related gallery pages but contain no cut semantic unit; p7->p8 is the same article at a clean boundary. Chinese-source zh->en baseline only; the official English edition supplies terminology reference.

Official Chinese WIPO Magazine Focus Music excerpt, 6 pages. pp1-4: V'ghn profile - display-title opener, two-column body, pull quotes, halftone portrait treatment and a quotation/photo page. pp5-6: separate 'Music merchandise: the new key to branding for musicians' feature opener and single-column body with large imagery. REAL mid-sentence split p2->p3 ('还与多个品牌合作，' -> '在观众中推广它们的产品。'). p3->p4 contains no cut unit, and p4->p5 is a different article. Adds cultural and entertainment subject matter plus highly designed portrait and photo-led pages. Chinese-source zh->en baseline only; official English articles supply terminology reference.
